# California Pizza Kitchen Dubai

> California Pizza Kitchen is an American casual-dining chain known for hearth-baked pizzas, pastas and salads. Its outlet at The Dubai Mall was the brand's first in the Middle East, covering about 5,500 square feet with seating for roughly 200 guests. The mall, in Downtown Dubai next to the Burj Khalifa, is one of the world's largest, combining more than 1,200 shops with an aquarium, a cinema and an ice rink.

## Project Overview

- Category: Residential / Commercial
- Location: Downtown Dubai, UAE
- Status: Completed

## MENASCO Scope

California Pizza Kitchen at The Dubai Mall was the American casual-dining brand's first restaurant in the Middle East, operated by franchise partner Gourmet Gulf Company in Downtown Dubai. MENASCO delivered the MEP works for the restaurant as a subcontractor to Bravacasa Interior Design. The project adds a flagship international restaurant brand to MENASCO's food and beverage portfolio.
